description: Drupal's states library for managing element states and dependencies, including state comparison, inversion, event handling, and dependency management.

classes.name: Drupal.states.State
classes.description: Represents a normalized state with support for negation and aliasing.

classes.name: Drupal.states.Dependent
classes.description: Represents an element that depends on other elements' states, managing constraints and reevaluation.

classes.name: Drupal.states.Trigger
classes.description: Handles event-based triggers for state changes on elements.

methods.name: invert
methods.description: Inverts a value if invertState is true and value is not undefined.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two values, ignoring undefined values.

methods.name: ternary
methods.description: Performs bitwise AND with a third undefined state.

methods.name: Drupal.states.State.sanitize
methods.description: Creates a sanitized State object from a string or existing State.
